{{DISPLAYTITLE:Bomb (''Tactics Advance'')}}
[[File:FFTABomb.jpg|right|200px]]
[[File:FFTABomb.png|left]]
{{Quote|Fiery, explosive creature. Deals fire damage.|Description}}
'''Bomb''' in ''[[Final Fantasy Tactics Advance]]'' is a flaming creature that can self-destruct to do massive damage. Being of the [[Fire (element)|Fire]] element, it is weak to [[Ice (element)|Ice]] and [[Water (element)|Water]]-based attacks. It is related to the Ice-elemental [[Grenade (Tactics Advance)|Grenade]] enemy.

If [[Firewyrm]]s accompany Bombs, such as in "Mission #047: Hot Recipe", it is best to kill the wyrms because they may use their [[Fire Breath]] to deal damage to the party and heal an injured Bomb at the same time.

{{See|Bomb (creature)}}
